# Muhammad Haseeb Sheikh

> Organic Growth Strategist specializing in healthcare SEO and local search. Finds the single constraint capping a business's organic growth and fixes it in the order that compounds.

Muhammad Haseeb Sheikh ("Haseeb") is an SEO and organic growth strategist. Documented results from prior engagements include growing a specialty clinic from 7,650 to 48,200 organic clicks per month and lifting its average Google position from 19 to 6.5 in six months. He works constraint-first and reports results in plain language, with every figure traceable to a real analytics dashboard. He is available for full-time roles, contract, or project work.
